steps.message:
This one touches security posture, so I want your explicit go-ahead before editing rather than after.

The change itself is one line — `config.js:3`, `SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES: 30` → `480`. The consequence is that it extends the window in which a stolen or abandoned session stays valid by 16×: a session hijacked via a leaked cookie, an unlocked laptop, or a shared machine stays usable for a full working day instead of half an hour. `server.js:2` confirms this value is the actual session expiry, not a UI-only idle hint.

That may well be exactly what you want (long-lived internal tooling, a dev environment, users complaining about being logged out mid-task). I just need the yes before I make it.
